outcome: frequency of hysterectomy by age and parity
frequency of abdominal vs. vaginal hysterectomy
cohort: 240 women who underwent hysterectomies at a rural tertiary teaching hospital in Medchal, India between January 2015 and December 2021.
finding: The most common indications for hysterectomy were abnormal uterine bleeding (36.25%), fibroids (34.58%), and uterine prolapse (29.16%), and abdominal hysterectomy (62.5%) was performed more frequently than vaginal hysterectomy (29.16%).
